target.description: Measured liquid-droplet diameter of a free-floating iso-octane droplet at times after the cutoff, as an unconditional predictive distribution over the droplet's state (hot flame, cool flame, no flame), plus the cumulative incidence of the end of the hot-flame phase.
excludes: flame temperature, soot, species or radiant emission
fibre-supported droplets unless fib.on = 1, and other fuels
a calibrated posterior: the spread is an assumed scenario distribution

features.name: c_logd0
features.transform: ln(sqrt(q0) / norm.d_ref_m); q0 = mean(D^2) over the head window advanced to t = 0 with the population rate at w = 0 @2

features.name: x_exc
features.transform: c_logd0 - N_crit(c_o2, c_co2, c_he, c_logp) = ln(D0 / D_crit) @2

features.name: s
features.transform: t * norm.k_ref_m2_s / q0 with t in seconds since the time origin (igniter energised) @1

features.name: e_late
features.transform: clamp(ln(max(K_obs, enc.k_floor_m2_s) / K_model), -enc.e_clip[0], enc.e_clip[1]); K_obs = finite difference of window means of D^2 (mid -> tail); K_model = harmonic Simpson mean of the hot-flame population rate over the same interval @2

features.name: e_early
features.transform: as e_late for head -> mid; both equal the head -> tail value when the mid window is empty @2

features.name: r_late
features.transform: K_obs / K_model of the late finite difference, unclamped (reported) @2

features.name: r_end
features.transform: K_obs / K_model of the finite difference between the last two end windows (enc.end_frac of the prefix each), unclamped: the state evidence @3

features.name: g_span
features.transform: ln((mean time of tail window - mean time of head window) / 1 s) @1

features.name: c_y
features.transform: mass fraction of component B in the liquid as deployed, y_b (a volume fraction phi converted: rho_b phi / (rho_a (1 - phi) + rho_b phi)); 0 with mix.on = 0 @1

features.name: c_ign
features.transform: ln(igniter_power * igniter_time / ig.e_ref), read with ig.on = 1 @1

features.name: fibre
features.transform: 1 for a fibre-supported droplet, 0 for a free one, read with fib.on = 1 @1

features.name: flame_seen
features.transform: 1 when the last positive flame diameter of either camera that has two more within fl.gap_s before it lies within fl.gap_s of the cutoff, 0 when the cameras recorded the flame (fl.min_points positive values after fl.t_min_s) and no longer show it; absent when they did not record it @1

tensors.name: rate.W1
tensors.description: Hidden weights of the hot-flame rate network ln(K_h/K_ref); row j reads x = (c_o2, c_co2, c_he, c_logp, c_logd0, w, s, c_y).

tensors.name: rate.b1
tensors.description: Hidden biases of the hot-flame rate network ln(K_h/K_ref) (hinge positions).

tensors.name: rate.w2
tensors.description: Output weights of the hot-flame rate network ln(K_h/K_ref) (slope changes at the hinges).

tensors.name: rate.skip
tensors.description: Linear part of the hot-flame rate network ln(K_h/K_ref) in x; every element is stated, including zeros.

tensors.name: rate.b0
tensors.description: ln(K_h/K_ref) at x = 0: air, 1e5 Pa, D0 = 2 mm, w = 0, s = 0, before hinge terms.

tensors.name: crit.W1
tensors.description: Hidden weights of the critical-diameter law ln(D_crit/D_ref); row j reads x = (c_o2, c_co2, c_he, c_logp, c_y).

tensors.name: crit.b1
tensors.description: Hidden biases of the critical-diameter law ln(D_crit/D_ref) (hinge positions).

tensors.name: crit.w2
tensors.description: Output weights of the critical-diameter law ln(D_crit/D_ref) (slope changes at the hinges).

tensors.name: crit.skip
tensors.description: Linear part of the critical-diameter law ln(D_crit/D_ref) in x; every element is stated, including zeros.

tensors.name: crit.b0
tensors.description: ln(D_crit/D_ref) in air at 1e5 Pa, before hinge terms: droplets larger than D_crit lose the hot flame to radiation.

tensors.name: class.kappa
tensors.description: Sharpness of the radiative class in x_exc = ln(D0/D_crit).

tensors.name: class.bias
tensors.description: Logit of the radiative class at D0 = D_crit.

tensors.name: diff.W1
tensors.description: Hidden weights of the diffusive-extinction law logit(w_D); row j reads x = (c_o2, c_co2, c_he, c_logp, c_logd0, x_exc, c_y).

tensors.name: diff.b1
tensors.description: Hidden biases of the diffusive-extinction law logit(w_D) (hinge positions).

tensors.name: diff.w2
tensors.description: Output weights of the diffusive-extinction law logit(w_D) (slope changes at the hinges).

tensors.name: diff.skip
tensors.description: Linear part of the diffusive-extinction law logit(w_D) in x; every element is stated, including zeros.

tensors.name: diff.b0
tensors.description: logit of the median burn progress at diffusive extinction at x = 0, before hinge terms.

tensors.name: diff.sharp
tensors.description: a_D: Gompertz sharpness of diffusive extinction in burn progress.

tensors.name: rad.W1
tensors.description: Hidden weights of the radiative-extinction law ln(s_R); row j reads x = (c_o2, c_co2, c_he, c_logp, c_logd0, x_exc, c_y).

tensors.name: rad.b1
tensors.description: Hidden biases of the radiative-extinction law ln(s_R) (hinge positions).

tensors.name: rad.w2
tensors.description: Output weights of the radiative-extinction law ln(s_R) (slope changes at the hinges).

tensors.name: rad.skip
tensors.description: Linear part of the radiative-extinction law ln(s_R) in x; every element is stated, including zeros.

tensors.name: rad.b0
tensors.description: ln of the median diffusion clock at radiative extinction at x = 0, before hinge terms.

tensors.name: rad.sharp
tensors.description: a_R: Gompertz sharpness of radiative extinction in s/s_R.

tensors.name: cool.p.W1
tensors.description: Hidden weights of the cool-flame onset logit after a radiative extinction; row j reads x = (c_o2, c_co2, c_he, c_logp, c_logd0, x_exc, c_y (y_s)).

tensors.name: cool.p.b1
tensors.description: Hidden biases of the cool-flame onset logit after a radiative extinction (hinge positions).

tensors.name: cool.p.w2
tensors.description: Output weights of the cool-flame onset logit after a radiative extinction (slope changes at the hinges).

tensors.name: cool.p.skip
tensors.description: Linear part of the cool-flame onset logit after a radiative extinction in x; every element is stated, including zeros.

tensors.name: cool.p.b0
tensors.description: Logit of a cool flame following radiative extinction at x = 0, before hinge terms.

tensors.name: cool.k.W1
tensors.description: Hidden weights of the cool-flame rate law ln(K_c/K_ref); row j reads x = (c_o2, c_co2, c_he, c_logp, c_logd0, c_y (y_s in cool.k)).

tensors.name: cool.k.b1
tensors.description: Hidden biases of the cool-flame rate law ln(K_c/K_ref) (hinge positions).

tensors.name: cool.k.w2
tensors.description: Output weights of the cool-flame rate law ln(K_c/K_ref) (slope changes at the hinges).

tensors.name: cool.k.skip
tensors.description: Linear part of the cool-flame rate law ln(K_c/K_ref) in x; every element is stated, including zeros.

tensors.name: cool.k.b0
tensors.description: ln(K_c/K_ref) at x = 0, before hinge terms.

tensors.name: cool.d.W1
tensors.description: Hidden weights of the cool-flame extinction-diameter law ln(D_ce/D_ref); row j reads x = (c_o2, c_co2, c_he, c_logp, c_logd0, c_y (y_s in cool.k)).

tensors.name: cool.d.b1
tensors.description: Hidden biases of the cool-flame extinction-diameter law ln(D_ce/D_ref) (hinge positions).

tensors.name: cool.d.w2
tensors.description: Output weights of the cool-flame extinction-diameter law ln(D_ce/D_ref) (slope changes at the hinges).

tensors.name: cool.d.skip
tensors.description: Linear part of the cool-flame extinction-diameter law ln(D_ce/D_ref) in x; every element is stated, including zeros.

tensors.name: cool.d.b0
tensors.description: ln(D_ce/D_ref) at x = 0, before hinge terms.

tensors.name: cool.d.sd
tensors.description: Assumed sd of ln D_ce between droplets of one condition.

tensors.name: post.cool_scale
tensors.description: Multiplier of post.k_hot after a cool flame (the surroundings are cooler than after a hot flame).

tensors.name: post.k_inf
tensors.description: Long-time d(D^2)/dt magnitude of an extinguished droplet of D = D_ref.

tensors.name: post.k_hot
tensors.description: Extra d(D^2)/dt magnitude right after extinction of a droplet of D = D_ref (the gas is still hot); decays with tau_e.

tensors.name: post.tau0_s
tensors.description: Decay time of post.k_hot for a droplet extinguished at D = D_ref.

tensors.name: post.size_exp
tensors.description: Exponent of (q_e/q_ref) in the long-time evaporation rate.

tensors.name: post.hot_exp
tensors.description: Exponent of (q_e/q_ref) in the amplitude of the extra evaporation right after extinction.

tensors.name: post.tau_exp
tensors.description: Exponent of (q_e/q_ref) in the decay time of the extra evaporation.

tensors.name: enc.gain_w
tensors.description: Weights of the gain logit on (g_span, g_count, g_progress).

tensors.name: enc.gain_b
tensors.description: Bias of the gain logit; gain = sigmoid(logit).

tensors.name: enc.mix
tensors.description: Weights of (e_late, e_early) in the run's log-rate innovation.

tensors.name: enc.e_clip
tensors.description: Clamp of the log-rate innovations: (below, above) the population rate.

tensors.name: enc.cool_gain
tensors.description: Share of the end-rate innovation against the cool-flame law that a cool flame burning at the cutoff keeps as its run offset.

tensors.name: filt.sd_hot
tensors.description: Assumed sd of the end-rate ratio r = K_obs/K_h of a droplet inside a hot flame (inside a cool flame: times K_c/K_h).

tensors.name: filt.sd_evap
tensors.description: Assumed sd of the end-rate ratio r = K_obs/K_h of a droplet without a flame.

tensors.name: filt.l_floor
tensors.description: Density added to every state's likelihood of r, so that an absurd r returns the prior.

tensors.name: filt.gain_w
tensors.description: Weights of the state-evidence exponent logit on (g_span, g_count, g_progress).

tensors.name: filt.gain_b
tensors.description: Bias of the state-evidence exponent logit; exponent = sigmoid(logit).

tensors.name: rob.eps_r
tensors.description: Probability that the radiative clock of this atmosphere is not the law's: weight of a clock with the same median s_R and survival 1 / (1 + s / s_R) in the survival of the radiative class (0: the law alone).

tensors.name: fl.trust
tensors.description: Probability that the flame cameras are right about the hot flame at the cutoff; the state at the cutoff is this weight on their verdict and the rest on the diameter's (0: the cameras are not read).

tensors.name: fl.t_min_s
tensors.description: Flame diameters before this time are not used (igniter glare and the ignition flash).

tensors.name: fl.gap_s
tensors.description: The hot flame counts as seen at the cutoff when the last positive flame diameter that has two more within this time before it lies at most this long before the cutoff.

tensors.name: fl.min_points
tensors.description: Fewest positive flame diameters after fl.t_min_s for the cameras to count as having recorded this flame.

tensors.name: fl.evap_mix
tensors.description: For a droplet whose flame the cameras lost before the cutoff: weight of the flame's heat left according to the time since it was lost, against the estimate from the end rate.

tensors.name: unc.s_pop
tensors.description: Assumed sd of a run's ln K around the population law before any prefix evidence.

tensors.name: unc.s_floor
tensors.description: Assumed sd of ln K that no prefix removes.

tensors.name: unc.sigma_d
tensors.description: Assumed sd of one diameter measurement around the latent diameter (level error included).

tensors.name: unc.sigma_frame
tensors.description: Assumed frame-to-frame sd of the diameter (what a finite difference of window means sees).

tensors.name: haz.log_disruption
tensors.description: ln of the constant disruption hazard of a burning droplet (reported, does not change the diameter).

tensors.name: norm.d_ref_m
tensors.description: Reference diameter of c_logd0, D_crit and D_ce.

tensors.name: norm.p_ref_pa
tensors.description: Reference pressure of c_logp.

tensors.name: norm.k_ref_m2_s
tensors.description: Reference burning-rate constant and clock rate.

tensors.name: norm.n_ref
tensors.description: Reference number of prefix points of g_count.

tensors.name: enc.window_frac
tensors.description: Head, mid and tail windows each span this fraction of the prefix duration.

tensors.name: enc.end_frac
tensors.description: The end rate is the finite difference between the means of D^2 over the last two windows of the prefix, each spanning this fraction of its duration; the level at the cutoff is carried from the last of them.

tensors.name: enc.k_floor_m2_s
tensors.description: Floor of an observed rate before its logarithm.

tensors.name: enc.w_ref
tensors.description: Progress at which g_progress saturates.

tensors.name: enc.min_points
tensors.description: Fewest valid prefix diameters for a forecast.

tensors.name: gate.growth_tol
tensors.description: A diameter is dropped when later prefix values of D^2 exceed it by more than this fraction.

tensors.name: gate.min_later
tensors.description: Number of later contradicting values that drops a diameter.

tensors.name: gate.k_max_m2_s
tensors.description: Largest d(D^2)/dt magnitude any flame of these experiments produces (twice the fastest measured rate): a later value below what this allows contradicts an earlier one, and the level is not carried to the cutoff faster than this.

tensors.name: num.dt_s
tensors.description: RK4 step of the hot phase (uniform grid from the cutoff).

tensors.name: num.bin_s
tensors.description: Width of the extinction-time bins the mixture atoms are built from.

tensors.name: num.d_min_m
tensors.description: Support floor: the model stops at this diameter.

tensors.name: num.t_valid_s
tensors.description: Model horizon since the time origin.

tensors.name: num.z_step
tensors.description: Spacing of the scenario nodes of z.

tensors.name: num.z_count
tensors.description: Number of scenario nodes of z, centred on 0.

tensors.name: num.ce_step
tensors.description: Spacing of the scenario nodes of the cool-flame extinction diameter.

tensors.name: num.ce_count
tensors.description: Number of scenario nodes of the cool-flame extinction diameter.

tensors.name: sc.on
tensors.description: Switch of the self-cooling law of a droplet without a flame, 0 or 1 (any other value is refused): 1 puts K(u) = K_floor(u) + K0 / (1 + u/t0) in place of the post.* law wherever that is used, u being the time since the flame ended; 0 keeps the post.* law and none of the sc.* entries is read.

tensors.name: sc.k0_hot_mm2_s
tensors.description: d(D^2)/dt magnitude, above the floor, of a droplet right after a hot flame left it, in a gas with g = 1: K0 = g * sc.k0_hot_mm2_s (times sc.diff_scale after a diffusive extinction).

tensors.name: sc.k0_cool_mm2_s
tensors.description: As sc.k0_hot_mm2_s for a droplet right after a cool flame left it: K0 = g * sc.k0_cool_mm2_s (not read for a fuel without a cool-flame law).

tensors.name: sc.tstar_k
tensors.description: Temperature the liquid has to lose for its evaporation on stored heat to stop, in the cooling time t0 = sc.tstar_k * sc.cl_j_kg_k * D_e^2 / (1.5 * K0 * sc.lat_j_kg) (D_e^2 in m2, K0 in m2/s; 0: no stored heat, the K0 term is absent).

tensors.name: sc.cl_j_kg_k
tensors.description: Specific heat of the liquid in the cooling time t0.

tensors.name: sc.lat_j_kg
tensors.description: Latent heat of evaporation in the cooling time t0 (0: evaporation costs no heat and the rate stays at K0).

tensors.name: sc.gas
tensors.description: Coefficients of (x_He, x_CO2, ln(p / norm.p_ref_pa)) in the gas factor g = exp(sc.gas . that) of K0 and of the cold floor; x are ambient mole fractions (x_He = 0.20 c_he, x_CO2 = 0.20 c_co2), p the pressure.

tensors.name: sc.k_cold_mm2_s
tensors.description: Long-time d(D^2)/dt magnitude of an unlit droplet in a gas with g = 1: K_floor(u) = g * k_cold + (k_warm - g * k_cold) * exp(-u / sc.tau_warm_s).

tensors.name: sc.k_warm_mm2_s
tensors.description: Floor of d(D^2)/dt right after the flame ended, while the surrounding gas is still warm (not multiplied by g).

tensors.name: sc.tau_warm_s
tensors.description: Time in which the floor goes from sc.k_warm_mm2_s to g * sc.k_cold_mm2_s.

tensors.name: sc.diff_scale
tensors.description: Multiplier of K0 and of both floor rates (sc.k_cold_mm2_s, sc.k_warm_mm2_s) for a droplet whose hot flame ended diffusively (burn-out or water extinction: the liquid left is less volatile); not applied after a radiative loss, after a cool flame, or to a droplet already without a flame at the cutoff.

tensors.name: dy.frac
tensors.description: A hot flame lost to radiation that no sustained cool flame follows dies away: the unlit droplet loses D^2 at dy.frac * K_c * exp(-u / dy.tau_s) on top of its unlit law, K_c the cool-flame rate of the run (0: no such term; a fuel without a cool-flame law has K_c = 0). Never after a diffusive extinction or a cool flame that burned.

tensors.name: dy.tau_s
tensors.description: Decay time of the dying flame.

tensors.name: ce.on
tensors.description: Switch of the closed form of the cool-flame end diameter, 0 or 1 (any other value is refused): 1 puts D_ce = D0 * (D0 / norm.d_ref_m)^(ce.d0_exp - 1) * ce.g0 * sqrt((ce.p_ref_atm - ce.beta_atm) / max(pO2 - ce.beta_atm, ce.eps_atm)) * (1 + ce.c_he * x_He), pO2 = x_O2 * p / 101325 Pa, in place of the median of the cool.d network, and a cool flame of zero length then leaves a droplet that comes straight from a hot flame; 0 keeps the network and none of the ce.* entries is read. Needs ce.p_ref_atm > ce.beta_atm. Not read for a fuel without a cool-flame law.

tensors.name: ce.g0
tensors.description: D_ce / D0 of a droplet of D0 = norm.d_ref_m at pO2 = ce.p_ref_atm without helium.

tensors.name: ce.beta_atm
tensors.description: Oxygen partial pressure at which the closed form of D_ce diverges (no cool flame is sustained below it).

tensors.name: ce.p_ref_atm
tensors.description: Oxygen partial pressure at which D_ce / D0 = ce.g0 for D0 = norm.d_ref_m without helium.

tensors.name: ce.eps_atm
tensors.description: Smallest pO2 - ce.beta_atm the closed form is evaluated at: closer to ce.beta_atm, or below it, D_ce is capped at its value there.

tensors.name: ce.c_he
tensors.description: Relative growth of D_ce per unit helium mole fraction: the factor (1 + ce.c_he * x_He).

tensors.name: ce.d0_exp
tensors.description: Exponent of D0 in D_ce (1: D_ce proportional to D0).

tensors.name: mix.on
tensors.description: Switch of the composition input, 0 or 1 (any other value is refused): 1 reads y_b (y_b_mass, or y_b_volume converted with mix.rho_a and mix.rho_b) and puts c_y = y_b as the last input of every law network (cool.p and cool.k read y_s); 0 reads no composition and c_y = 0.

tensors.name: mix.rho_a
tensors.description: Liquid density of component A at 298 K, for converting a volume fraction to y_b.

tensors.name: mix.rho_b
tensors.description: Liquid density of component B at 298 K, for converting a volume fraction to y_b.

tensors.name: ce.beta_y
tensors.description: With mix.on = 1 the oxygen limit of the closed form of the cool-flame end is ce.beta_atm + ce.beta_y * y_s.

tensors.name: ce.g0_y
tensors.description: With mix.on = 1, ce.g0 is multiplied by exp(ce.g0_y * y_s).

tensors.name: st.on
tensors.description: Switch of staged burning, 0 or 1 (any other value is refused); needs mix.on = 1. For y_b > 0 a hot or cool flame that reaches D_c = D0 [1 + 3 st.eps (1 - y_b)/y_b]^(-1/3) exp(st.dc_sd u) enters stage 2.

tensors.name: st.eps
tensors.description: Liquid diffusion number 8 D_l / K of the mixture in stage 1.

tensors.name: st.dc_sd
tensors.description: Assumed sd of ln D_c between droplets (nodes num.dc_count spaced num.dc_step).

tensors.name: st.drift
tensors.description: Surface composition seen by the cool-flame laws: y_s = clamp(y_b + st.drift * w, 0, 1), w the burn progress (0: the liquid keeps its composition). Read with mix.on = 1.

tensors.name: st.k2
tensors.description: ln of the stage-2 rate over the stage-1 law at the same state.

tensors.name: st.dip_amp
tensors.description: At D_c the rate is multiplied by 1 - st.dip_amp * exp(-(s - s_c) / st.dip_clock): the surface heating to its new temperature (section 3.2's st.dip[0]).

tensors.name: st.dip_clock
tensors.description: Clock length of the dip at D_c (section 3.2's st.dip[1]; s = t * norm.k_ref_m2_s / q0).

tensors.name: st.flash.W1
tensors.description: Hidden weights of the flash-extinction logit at D_c; row j reads x = (c_o2, c_co2, c_he, c_logp, c_logd0, x_exc, c_y).

tensors.name: st.flash.b1
tensors.description: Hidden biases of the flash-extinction logit at D_c (hinge positions).

tensors.name: st.flash.w2
tensors.description: Output weights of the flash-extinction logit at D_c (slope changes at the hinges).

tensors.name: st.flash.skip
tensors.description: Linear part of the flash-extinction logit at D_c in x; every element is stated, including zeros.

tensors.name: st.flash.b0
tensors.description: Logit of the probability that the hot flame is lost at D_c (flash extinction), before hinge terms.

tensors.name: st.log_disruption2
tensors.description: ln of the disruption hazard of a hot flame in stage 2, in place of haz.log_disruption.

tensors.name: warm.on
tensors.description: Switch of the warm-flame stage after a radiative loss, 0 or 1 (any other value is refused).

tensors.name: warm.p.W1
tensors.description: Hidden weights of the logit that the stage after a radiative loss begins as a warm flame; row j reads x = (c_o2, c_co2, c_he, c_logp, c_logd0, x_exc, c_y).

tensors.name: warm.p.b1
tensors.description: Hidden biases of the logit that the stage after a radiative loss begins as a warm flame (hinge positions).

tensors.name: warm.p.w2
tensors.description: Output weights of the logit that the stage after a radiative loss begins as a warm flame (slope changes at the hinges).

tensors.name: warm.p.skip
tensors.description: Linear part of the logit that the stage after a radiative loss begins as a warm flame in x; every element is stated, including zeros.

tensors.name: warm.p.b0
tensors.description: Logit of a warm flame after a radiative loss at x = 0, before hinge terms.

tensors.name: warm.k
tensors.description: ln(K_warm / K_c): the warm flame burns at K_c exp(warm.k).

tensors.name: warm.s.W1
tensors.description: Hidden weights of the law ln(s_W) of the median clock length of the warm stage; row j reads x = (c_o2, c_co2, c_he, c_logp, c_logd0, x_exc, c_y).

tensors.name: warm.s.b1
tensors.description: Hidden biases of the law ln(s_W) of the median clock length of the warm stage (hinge positions).

tensors.name: warm.s.w2
tensors.description: Output weights of the law ln(s_W) of the median clock length of the warm stage (slope changes at the hinges).

tensors.name: warm.s.skip
tensors.description: Linear part of the law ln(s_W) of the median clock length of the warm stage in x; every element is stated, including zeros.

tensors.name: warm.s.b0
tensors.description: ln of the median clock length of the warm stage at x = 0, before hinge terms.

tensors.name: warm.sharp
tensors.description: Gompertz sharpness of the end of the warm stage in s/s_W, as rad.sharp.

tensors.name: ig.on
tensors.description: Switch of direct cool ignition, 0 or 1 (any other value is refused): 1 reads the conditions igniter_power and igniter_time.

tensors.name: ig.cool.W1
tensors.description: Hidden weights of the logit that ignition gives a cool flame and no hot flame; row j reads x = (c_o2, c_co2, c_he, c_logp, c_logd0, x_exc, c_y, c_ign).

tensors.name: ig.cool.b1
tensors.description: Hidden biases of the logit that ignition gives a cool flame and no hot flame (hinge positions).

tensors.name: ig.cool.w2
tensors.description: Output weights of the logit that ignition gives a cool flame and no hot flame (slope changes at the hinges).

tensors.name: ig.cool.skip
tensors.description: Linear part of the logit that ignition gives a cool flame and no hot flame in x; every element is stated, including zeros.

tensors.name: ig.cool.b0
tensors.description: Logit of a cool flame lit directly by the igniter at x = 0, before hinge terms.

tensors.name: fib.on
tensors.description: Switch of fibre-supported droplets, 0 or 1 (any other value is refused): 1 reads the condition fiber (0 or 1); 0 refuses a prefix with fiber = 1.

tensors.name: fib.rate
tensors.description: Added to ln K_h for a supported droplet (heat conducted along the fibre).

tensors.name: fib.crit
tensors.description: Added to ln D_crit for a supported droplet.

tensors.name: num.dc_step
tensors.description: Spacing of the scenario nodes of ln D_c.

tensors.name: num.dc_count
tensors.description: Number of scenario nodes of ln D_c.

tensors.name: num.warm_count
tensors.description: Number of equal-mass quantile nodes of the warm-stage clock length.

tensors.name: ig.e_ref
tensors.description: Reference igniter energy of c_ign = ln(igniter_power * igniter_time / ig.e_ref).

notes: Prefix observations: liquid_diameter, valid, positive, 0 <= t <= cutoff, first of equal time stamps, then the validity gate (a value is dropped when at least gate.min_later later prefix values of D^2 contradict it: larger by more than gate.growth_tol, since a droplet does not grow, or smaller than gate.k_max_m2_s allows in the time between). Level at the cutoff: mean of D^2 over the last end window carried to the cutoff along the end rate (finite difference of the last two end windows) limited to [0, min(gate.k_max_m2_s, twice the mid -> tail rate)] (no weight enters it). Survival of the radiative class at clock s: S_R(s) = (1 - rob.eps_r) exp(-Lambda_R(s)) + rob.eps_r / (1 + s / s_R), in the prior at the cutoff and, divided by its value at the cutoff, in the forecast. State probabilities at the cutoff: prior from the extinction laws at the observed progress and clock, times (N(r_end; mean_state, sd_state) + filt.l_floor)^g, normalised, g = sigmoid(filt.gain_b + filt.gain_w . (g_span, g_count, g_progress)); means 1 (hot), K_c/K_h (cool), k_evap/K_h (no flame, half of the post-extinction transient left); sds from filt.sd_hot, filt.sd_evap and the finite-difference noise implied by unc.sigma_frame. Run offset of the hot flame: gain times the clamped mid -> tail and head -> mid innovations; of a cool flame burning at the cutoff: enc.cool_gain * g * clamped ln(end rate / K_c). A droplet without a flame at the cutoff evaporates with the transient amplitude its end rate shows (weight g) or half of post.k_hot (weight 1 - g). Flame cameras (fl.trust > 0, and the prefix holds at least fl.min_points positive uv_flame_diameter or visible_flame_diameter values in [fl.t_min_s, cutoff]): t_last is the last of those times that has two more within fl.gap_s before it; the flame is seen when cutoff - t_last <= fl.gap_s. The state probabilities after the rate evidence, s, become fl.trust * v + (1 - fl.trust) * s with v = (1, 0, 0) when the flame is seen and v = (0, s_cool, s_none) / (s_cool + s_none) otherwise (the law's cool-flame probability at the cutoff in place of that ratio when s_cool + s_none = 0). When the flame is not seen the transient amplitude of a droplet without a flame is fl.evap_mix * exp(-(cutoff - t_last) / tau_e) + (1 - fl.evap_mix) * (the end-rate estimate). Nothing else is read from the flame diameters. Self-cooling law (sc.on = 1), in place of the post.* law of a droplet without a flame: fall of D^2 over the first u seconds after the flame ended at D_e^2 = q_e, J(u) = K0 t0 ln(1 + u/t0) + g f k_cold u + (f k_warm - g f k_cold) sc.tau_warm_s (1 - exp(-u/sc.tau_warm_s)), t0 = sc.tstar_k sc.cl_j_kg_k q_e / (1.5 K0 sc.lat_j_kg), g = exp(sc.gas . (x_He, x_CO2, ln(p/norm.p_ref_pa))), K0 = g f sc.k0_hot_mm2_s after a hot flame and g sc.k0_cool_mm2_s after a cool flame (where the post.* law applies post.cool_scale), f = sc.diff_scale after a diffusive extinction and 1 otherwise, rates converted from mm2/s. No-flame mean of the state evidence: (K_floor(0) + K0 / 2) / K_h with the hot K0 and f = 1. A droplet without a flame at the cutoff: J restarted at the cutoff from the diameter at the cutoff with K0 times (g_state * clamp((end rate - K_floor(0)) / K0, 0, 3) + (1 - g_state) / 2); when the cameras lost the flame at t_last, fl.evap_mix * (J(t - t_last) - J(cutoff - t_last)) + (1 - fl.evap_mix) * that. Dying flame (dy.frac > 0): after a radiative loss with no cool flame, and for a cool flame of zero length when ce.on = 1, the fall of D^2 gains dy.frac K_c dy.tau_s (1 - exp(-u/dy.tau_s)), K_c the cool-flame rate of the scenario. Cool-flame end (ce.on = 1): the median D_ce is D0 (D0/norm.d_ref_m)^(ce.d0_exp - 1) ce.g0 sqrt((ce.p_ref_atm - ce.beta_atm) / max(pO2 - ce.beta_atm, ce.eps_atm)) (1 + ce.c_he x_He), pO2 = x_O2 p / 101325 Pa, D0 = sqrt(q0), in place of the cool.d network's; a node with D_ce at or above the diameter at the hot flame's loss then leaves a droplet that comes straight from a hot flame (with ce.on = 0: from a cool flame). With sc.on = 0, dy.frac = 0 and ce.on = 0 the forecast is that of droplet5.rs. The law is that of droplet6.rs; this forward adds fuels, widens c_logp and c_he and moves the horizon. The prefix's fuel condition names this fuel after lower-casing and dropping a leading n- and every space, hyphen, underscore and comma, component by component. Sections 3.2 and 3.3 (droplet9.rs): composition c_y (mix.on), staged burning at D_c with flash extinction, a stage-2 rate factor exp(st.k2) (1 - st.dip_amp exp(-(s - s_c)/st.dip_clock)) and stage-2 disruption (st.on), a warm stage after a radiative loss (warm.on), direct cool ignition (ig.on), fibre-supported droplets (fib.on); with every switch off the forecast is that of droplet8.rs. Hot phase: RK4 on a uniform grid of num.dt_s from the cutoff, linear interpolation to the forecast times; extinction mass collected in bins of num.bin_s; everything after a transition is closed form. Scenario nodes z_k = (k - (n-1)/2) * z_step with weights proportional to exp(-z^2/2), for the rate and, independently, for ln D_ce. Predictive quantiles: quantiles of the mixture of Gaussians of sd unc.sigma_d centred on the mixture atoms (atoms pooled on a grid of sigma_d/4; each quantile by bisection of the monotone mixture CDF). Latent quantiles: step quantiles of the atoms. Uncertainty kind: assumed_noise.
